```{r load-expression-and-parameters, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
rna_input_dir <- "/Users/eve/Dropbox/tmp_work/RNA_counts/new_norm"

dose_columns <- list(
  k1f = c("r3_O1", "r3_O1d5", "r3_O2", "r3_O2d5",
          "r3_O3", "r3_O3d5", "r3_O4", "r3_O5"),
  k3h = c("r3_N1", "r3_N1d5", "r3_N2", "r3_N2d5",
          "r3_N3", "r3_N3d5", "r3_N4", "r3_N5"),
  k4fh = c("r3_S1", "r3_S1d5", "r3_S2", "r3_S2d5",
           "r3_S3", "r3_S3d5", "r3_S4", "r3_S5")
)
reporter_order_names <- c(
  "s5", "s4", "s3d5", "s3", "s2d5", "s2", "s1d5", "s1"
)

read_endogenous_matrix <- function(condition, statistic = c("mean", "SE")) {
  statistic <- match.arg(statistic)
  filename <- paste0(
    if (statistic == "mean") "mean_" else "SE_",
    condition,
    "_external_norm_RPK.txt"
  )
  input <- read.table(
    file.path(rna_input_dir, filename),
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(dose_columns[[condition]], "gene", "id")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(input))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(filename, " is missing columns: ",
         paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }

  missing_id <- is.na(input$id) | input$id == ""
  input$id[missing_id] <- paste0("symbol:", input$gene[missing_id])
  if (anyDuplicated(input$id)) {
    stop(filename, " contains duplicated gene IDs")
  }

  expression <- input[, rev(dose_columns[[condition]]), drop = FALSE]
  # Match the source notebook: add one pseudocount to mean expression only.
  if (statistic == "mean") {
    expression <- expression + 1
  }
  names(expression) <- reporter_order_names
  row.names(expression) <- input$id
  expression
}

f_mean <- read_endogenous_matrix("k1f", "mean")
f_se <- read_endogenous_matrix("k1f", "SE")
h_mean <- read_endogenous_matrix("k3h", "mean")
h_se <- read_endogenous_matrix("k3h", "SE")
fh_mean <- read_endogenous_matrix("k4fh", "mean")
fh_se <- read_endogenous_matrix("k4fh", "SE")

bc_full_list <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    row.names(f_mean), row.names(f_se),
    row.names(h_mean), row.names(h_se),
    row.names(fh_mean), row.names(fh_se)
  )
)
f_hsp_matrix_3rMean <- f_mean[bc_full_list, , drop = FALSE]
h_hsp_matrix_3rMean <- h_mean[bc_full_list, , drop = FALSE]
fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean <- fh_mean[bc_full_list, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r curve-functions, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set_canvas <- function(x, xlab, xat, xlabels = "", ylim = c(1, 10000),
                       cex_lab = 1, ylab = "Gene expression (nRPK)") {
  plot(
    x, (seq_along(x) - 0.995) * 36,
    log = "xy", pch = 16, cex = 0, col = "white",
    axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE, ylim = ylim
  )
  axis(
    2,
    at = c(1, 100, 10000, 1000000),
    labels = expression(10^0, 10^2, 10^4, 10^6),
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.02, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
    col.ticks = "black", padj = 1.3, cex.axis = 0.8
  )
  axis(
    1, at = xat, labels = xlabels,
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.02, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
    col.ticks = "black", padj = -2, cex.axis = 0.8
  )
  title(
    ylab = ylab,
    xlab = xlab,
    line = 1.2,
    cex.lab = cex_lab
  )
  box()
}

add_top_axis <- function() {
  axis(
    3, at = fh_labels, labels = h_c_labels,
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.02, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
    col.ticks = "black", padj = 1.78, cex.axis = 0.8
  )
}

get_tissue_indices <- function(tissue_file, fitted_genes) {
  tissue_table <- read.delim(
    tissue_file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  which(
    unversioned_gene_ids %in% unique(tissue_table$Ensembl) &
      bc_full_list %in% fitted_genes
  )
}

tissue_title <- function(tissue_file, n) {
  tissue_name <- sub("\\.tsv$", "", basename(tissue_file))
  tissue_name <- gsub("_", " ", tissue_name)
  tissue_name <- paste0(
    toupper(substr(tissue_name, 1, 1)),
    substr(tissue_name, 2, nchar(tissue_name))
  )
  title(
    main = paste0(tissue_name, " (n=", n, ")"),
    cex.main = 0.9,
    font.main = 1
  )
}
```

```{r prepare-curve-colors, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
tissue_n <- vapply(
  tissue_files,
  function(tissue_file) {
    length(get_tissue_indices(
      tissue_file,
      row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh)
    ))
  },
  numeric(1)
)
keep_tissue <- tissue_n > 0
tissue_files <- tissue_files[keep_tissue]
tissue_n <- tissue_n[keep_tissue]
tissue_order <- order(-tissue_n, basename(tissue_files))
tissue_files <- tissue_files[tissue_order]
tissue_n <- tissue_n[tissue_order]

make_curve_colors <- function(fold_change, palette, cutoff = 1.5) {
  colors <- rep(NA_character_, length(fold_change))
  colors[fold_change <= cutoff] <- "#C5C5C5"
  above_cutoff <- which(fold_change > cutoff)
  colors[above_cutoff] <- colorRampPalette(palette)(length(above_cutoff))[
    rank(fold_change[above_cutoff])
  ]
  colors
}

fold_change_1 <- f_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1 / f_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5
sort_metric_1 <- abs(fold_change_1 - 1.9) * 1.2 -
  abs(f_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1 - 2.5) +
  (f_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5 + f_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s4) / 1.2
sort_metric_1[!bc_full_list %in% row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f)] <- NA_real_
all_colors_1 <- make_curve_colors(
  fold_change_1,
  c("#FBE9E9", "#F5C6C9", "#E86F77")
)

fold_change_3 <- h_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1 / h_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5
sort_metric_3 <- abs(fold_change_3 - 1.9) * 1.1 -
  abs(h_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1 - 1.9) +
  h_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5 + h_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s4
sort_metric_3[!bc_full_list %in% row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h)] <- NA_real_
all_colors_3 <- make_curve_colors(
  fold_change_3,
  c("#D2E4F6", "#A2C9ED", "#4192D9")
)

fold_change_4 <- fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1 / fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5
sort_metric_4 <- -abs(fold_change_4)
sort_metric_4[!bc_full_list %in% row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh)] <- NA_real_
all_colors_4 <- make_curve_colors(
  fold_change_4,
  c("#E4DEEA", "#C9BCD6", "#9075ab")
)

draw_tissue_curves <- function(
    tissue_file, expression_matrix, fitted_genes, sort_metric, colors,
    concentration, xlab, xat, xlabels, top_axis = FALSE,
    show_ylab = FALSE) {
  tissue_indices <- get_tissue_indices(tissue_file, fitted_genes)

  set_canvas(
    x = concentration,
    xlab = xlab,
    xat = xat,
    xlabels = xlabels,
    ylim = curve_ylim,
    cex_lab = 0.9,
    ylab = if (show_ylab) "Gene expression (nRPK)" else ""
  )
  if (top_axis) add_top_axis()
  tissue_title(tissue_file, length(tissue_indices))

  tissue_plot_order <- intersect(
    order(sort_metric, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA),
    tissue_indices
  )
  for (i in tissue_plot_order) {
    lines(concentration, expression_matrix[i, ], col = "white", lwd = 1.5)
    lines(
      concentration, expression_matrix[i, ],
      col = alpha(colors[i], 1), lwd = 1
    )
  }
}
```

```{r tissue-curves-1-3-4, eval=TRUE, fig.width=8.7, fig.height=4, out.width='100%', echo=FALSE, dpi=600, warning=FALSE, results='show'}
par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1)
)
# A three-column mfrow layout automatically reduces base R's cex to 0.66.
# Reset it so text sizes match the original single-panel plots.
par(cex = 1, mex = 1)

for (tissue_file in tissue_files) {
  draw_tissue_curves(
    tissue_file = tissue_file,
    expression_matrix = f_hsp_matrix_3rMean,
    fitted_genes = row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f),
    sort_metric = sort_metric_1,
    colors = all_colors_1,
    concentration = conc_foxa1,
    xlab = "[FOXA1] (nM)",
    xat = f_c_labels,
    xlabels = f_c_labels,
    show_ylab = TRUE
  )

  draw_tissue_curves(
    tissue_file = tissue_file,
    expression_matrix = h_hsp_matrix_3rMean,
    fitted_genes = row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h),
    sort_metric = sort_metric_3,
    colors = all_colors_3,
    concentration = conc_hnf4a_alone,
    xlab = "[HNF4A] (nM)",
    xat = h_c_labels2,
    xlabels = h_c_labels2
  )

  draw_tissue_curves(
    tissue_file = tissue_file,
    expression_matrix = fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean,
    fitted_genes = row.names(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh),
    sort_metric = sort_metric_4,
    colors = all_colors_4,
    concentration = fxh_con,
    xlab = "[FOXA1] (nM)",
    xat = fh_labels,
    xlabels = f_c_labels,
    top_axis = TRUE
  )
}
```
